sec09-EFFECTIVE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at A/A.01 | No effective date is established by the revision label; retain the accepted effective-date disposition.
sec09-BANK | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at A/A.01 | No total knowledge-test question-bank size has been verified.
sec09-DEAD-RED-PROCEDURE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 81 L8-11 gives bicycle crossing permission when a signal does not respond, after a rider-determined reasonable wait without impeding cross traffic or causing a crash. It does not state an initial stop or an objective wait threshold. The complete red-signal procedure remains debt; do not extend it to other vehicles or invent a number.
sec09-HAND-SIGNAL-VISUALS | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 82 L4 has only captions for stopping, left-turn and two right-turn hand signals. Arm positions cannot be established from captions; visual identification remains debt until registered images are inspected.
sec09-MOTORCYCLE-STATISTICS | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 83 L34-37 gives approximately one-half of motorcycle/scooter/moped crashes involving another motor vehicle and nearly40 percent caused by the other vehicle turning left. Study date, jurisdiction and the latter denominator are not established; neither statistic becomes a current risk rate.
sec09-COMMERCIAL-CRASH-STATISTICS | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 85 L34-36 says over250000 annual car/commercial crashes and car-driver contribution in more than70 percent of fatal mixed crashes. Study date, geographic population and attribution method are missing; preserve both figures as statistical debt.
sec09-TRUCK-CAR-COMPARISON | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 86 L19-24 gives an ideal-condition loaded-truck stop at55 mph of at least335 feet and greater than1.5 times a car's distance. The truck example is retained with conditions; the car's specification and comparison basis remain unverified.
sec09-TRUCK-GRADE-SPEED | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 86 L36-39 describes large vehicles on steep hills as needing to travel approximately35 mph in the right lane. No vehicle/load/grade conditions establish a universal truck speed; do not teach35 mph as a legal limit or guarantee.
sec09-TRUCK-FRONT-ABSOLUTE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 86 L24-28 says not to enter or change lanes in front of a large vehicle, then permits returning after passing when the whole front is visible. The unconditional ban needs scope clarification; supported safe passing clearance is retained.
sec09-TRANSIT-BEHIND-SCOPE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 87 L36-37 says no transit-bus boarding stop is required unless behind the bus, without specifying lane or passing circumstances. Do not turn this into an all-lane behind-bus stopping rule.
sec09-RAIL-TRACK-ABSOLUTE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 87 L41-43 prohibits driving through or parking on tracks for any reason, while page88 L4-5 allows sharing a trolley/light-rail lane in many cases. The track-travel prohibition requires scope reconciliation; the pedestrian safety-zone restriction is separately supported.
sec09-FARM-HEARING-ABSOLUTE | source_missing | owner EvidenceLibrarian | tier official | at D/D.01 | Page 88 L20-22 categorically says farm-equipment operators cannot hear approaching vehicles. Noise and equipment conditions are unspecified; do not assume either that a horn will be heard or that every operator is unable to hear.

Dynamic facts: Edition-bound legal definitions and distances require issuer refresh. Undated statistics, red-signal procedure, sign-image geometry and contradictory instructions remain typed debt; no current-law clearance is implied.
Official exam metadata comes only from the bound source scope; pedagogic emphasis is not an official domain weighting. Independent factual QA remains pending.
